k30.e: Polling is therefore a listening instrument, not a truth machine.
k30.t: szid gu3 un-ka gesz gesztu2-ka-am3 • gesz dim2-ma nig2-gi-na-ka nu-am3
k30.g: the counting of the people's voice is an instrument of the ear; it is not a machine of the firm truth

k30.e: It can reveal needs, priorities, disagreements, fears, opportunities, and ideas.
k30.t: nig2 al-di • nig2 sag • inim bar-ra • nig2 husz • kaskal sig5 • u3 inim sza3-ga pa mu-un-e3
k30.g: it brings to light the desired things, the head-things (priorities), the divided words, the fearsome things, the good roads (opportunities), and the heart's words (ideas)

k30.e: AI can help translate languages, organize responses, expose patterns, and make participation understandable.
k30.t: gesztu2 dim2-ma-e eme mu-un-bal • inim un-ka si mu-un-sa2 • gesz-hur pa mu-un-e3 • kaskal un-ra mu-un-zu-zu
k30.g: the fashioned understanding turns the tongue (translates) • sets the people's words in order • brings the pattern to light • teaches the road to the people

k30.e: But popularity does not determine physics.
k30.g: the people's delight does not decide the firm truth of the earth

k30.e: A majority cannot vote an unsafe bridge into being safe.
k30.t: un gal-e nig2 nu-gi-na inim-ta gi-na nu-mu-un-dim2
k30.g: the many people cannot, by word alone, fashion the un-firm thing into a firm one

k30.e: A leader may disagree with a poll, but should preserve the disagreement and the reason for choosing differently.
k30.t: lugal-e inim un-ka he2-tar • inim bar-ra-bi u3 inim sza3-bi he2-sar
k30.g: a king may cut against the people's word • let him write down the divided word and the word of his heart (his reason)

k30.e: Minority concerns should remain visible because today’s minority warning can become tomorrow’s discovered truth.
k30.t: gu3 un tur-ra igi-a he2-gub • gu3 un tur-ra u4-ne-ka nig2-gi-na pad3-da u4 egir-ra-ka he2-gal2
k30.g: let the small people's cry stand in view • the small people's cry of today may come to exist as the found truth of the after-days

k30.e: The record should show what Humanity expressed, what evidence existed, what accountable Humans ultimately decided, and what happened afterward.
k30.t: dub-e inim nam-lu2-ulu3-ka • nig2-gi-na gal2-la • ka-asz bar-ra lu2-ne-ka • u3 nig2 egir-ra gal2-la he2-sar
k30.g: let the tablet write the word of humankind, the proof that existed, the decision of the answerable persons, and what came to exist afterward

k31.e: Thought Mastery turns listening into learning.
k31.g: thought-mastery turns the ear into learning

k31.e: It asks participants to distinguish being heard from automatically being obeyed, and leaders to distinguish authority from the power to erase disagreement.
k31.t: un-e he2-zu • inim szu tuku-a inim-sze3 gub-ba nu-am3 • lugal-e he2-zu • nam-en a2 inim bar-ra usz-a nu-am3
k31.g: let the people know: a word received in the hand is not a standing-under-the-word (obedience) • let the leader know: lordship is not an arm that puts the divided word to death

k31.e: This is how Vision • 2525 approaches unity without uniformity.
k31.t: ur5-gin7 ⟦Vision • 2525⟧ sza3 disz-sze3 kaskal mu-un-pad3 • igi disz nu-mu-un-al-di
k31.g: thus Vision • 2525 finds the road toward one heart • it does not desire one face

k31.e: Humanity does not need one worldview.
k31.g: humankind does not require a single eye upon the world

k31.e: It needs enough shared language to coordinate across difference while protecting legitimate sovereignty, identity, culture, and responsibility.
k31.t: inim disz szu-sze3 he2-tuku • un bar-bar-ra kin disz-sze3 he2-gen • nam-lugal-bi mu-bi me-bi nam-kin-bi szu he2-tuku
k31.g: may it hold one word in hand • may the divided peoples go toward one work • may their kingship, their name, their ME (culture), and their duty be held safe
the people's understanding seizes the voice (gathers the signal)
the fashioned understanding gives humankind the knowing of it
the person's understanding weighs the aftermath

k31.t: dub gi4-gi4-e ka-asz bar-ra szu mu-un-tuku
k31.g: the returning tablet holds the decision in hand
the true ground gives the proof

k31.e: The next cycle begins better informed.
k31.t: kaskal gi4-gi4 egir-bi zu-a gal-ta mu-un-gub
k31.g: the returning road that follows stands upon greater knowing

k31.e: Civilization becomes more intelligent not when everyone agrees, but when disagreement can enter a trustworthy process, remain visible through decision, encounter reality, and leave learning behind.
k31.t: sza3 disz-e kalam gesztu2 nu-mu-un-sum • inim bar-ra kaskal gi-na-sze3 he2-gen • igi-a he2-gub • ki zi he2-te • zu-zu egir-bi-sze3 he2-sum • ur5-ta kalam gesztu2 mu-un-tuku
k31.g: one-heartedness alone does not give the land understanding • let the divided word go into a firm road • let it stand in view • let it approach the true ground • let it give learning to what follows • from this the land gains understanding

k32.e: Human imagination is powerful because it can visit futures that do not yet exist.
k32.t: igi sza3-ga lu2-ka a2 mah tuku-am3 • u4 egir-ra nu-gal2-la-sze3 mu-un-gen
k32.g: the heart's eye (imagination) of a person has great strength • it goes to after-days that do not yet exist

k32.e: For most of history, however, testing those futures required exposing the physical world to them.
k32.t: u4-bi-ta ki zi-e u4 egir-ra-bi mu-un-la2
k32.g: in the former days, the true ground itself weighed those futures
the built house afterward did not stand

k32.t: gesz dim2-ma gub-ba-ta nig2 sig-bi pa mu-un-e3
k32.g: the fashioned implement, once set up, brought its weakness to light

k32.e: Policies exposed consequences after affecting people.
k32.t: inim lugal-la un-ra te-a-ta egir-bi pa mu-un-e3
k32.g: the king's word, after touching the people, brought forth its aftermath

k32.e: Modern simulation creates another possibility: thought can encounter some consequences before Humanity must.
k32.t: u4-ne-a igi-bar gal2-am3 • gesztu2-e egir-bi igi nam-lu2-ulu3-ka he2-zu
k32.g: today the looking-upon (simulation) exists • may thought know its aftermath before humankind must
may the design be fashioned within the looking-upon
may the task be repeated within the looking-upon
may the heart's word (assumption) be weighed
may a person come to know the hand of the fashioned implement

k32.e: Failure can occur digitally before people, infrastructure, resources, or environments are unnecessarily placed at risk.
k32.t: nig2 nu-gub-ba igi-bar-ra he2-gal2 • un e2 nig2 u3 ki-bi nu-mu-un-te
k32.g: let the failing occur within the looking-upon • it does not touch the people, the houses, the goods, or the ground

k32.e: Simulation therefore gives imagination a place to meet constraint.
k32.t: igi-bar-e igi sza3-ga-ra ki esh2-ka mu-un-sum
k32.g: the looking-upon gives the heart's eye the place of the rope (constraint)

k32.e: It allows a proposed future to encounter models of reality before Humanity decides whether greater exposure is justified, while preserving the obligation to remember that a model remains a model.
k32.t: u4 egir-ra gesz-hur-ra ki zi igi-bar-ra mu-un-te • igi ka-asz bar-ra nam-lu2-ulu3-ka • u3 he2-zu • igi-bar igi-bar-am3 • ki zi nu-am3
k32.g: the planned after-day meets the true ground within the looking-upon, before humankind's decision • and know this: the looking-upon is a looking-upon — it is not the true ground

k33.e: Vision • 2525 places simulation between imagination and increasing levels of exposure.
k33.t: ⟦Vision • 2525⟧ igi-bar sza3 igi sza3-ga u3 ki zi-ka mu-un-gub
k33.g: Vision • 2525 stands the looking-upon in the midst between the heart's eye and the true ground

k33.e: But it protects an equally important boundary: simulation is not reality.
k33.t: inim gal he2-gub • igi-bar ki zi nu-am3
k33.g: let the great word stand: the looking-upon is not the true ground

k33.e: Visualization may help Humans understand a design without proving it works.
k33.t: igi-ta lu2-e gesz-hur mu-un-zu • nig2-gi-na-bi nu-mu-un-sum
k33.g: by the eye a person comes to know the design • it does not give its proof

k33.e: Simulation may test assumptions without validating a physical system.
k33.t: igi-bar-e inim sza3-ga mu-un-la2 • nig2-gi-na gesz dim2-ma-ka nu-mu-un-gar
k33.g: the looking-upon weighs the heart's word • it does not establish the firm truth of the physical implement

k33.e: Human experience may reveal confusion or opportunity without becoming engineering evidence.
k33.t: zu-a lu2-ka-ke4 sza3 bar-bar u3 kaskal sig5 pa mu-un-e3 • nig2-gi-na kin-ka nu-am3
k33.g: a person's lived knowing brings to light the divided heart (confusion) or the good road (opportunity) • it is not the proof of the craft

k33.e: Verification, validation, qualification, and real-world testing remain distinct responsibilities.
k33.t: nig2-szid • la2-a • inim nig2-gi-na-ka • u3 la2 ki zi-ka • nam-kin bar-ra disz-disz-am3
k33.g: the reckoning (verification), the weighing (validation), the word-of-proof (qualification), and the weighing on the true ground — each is a separate duty, one by one
the looking-upon does not make the true ground die

k33.e: Its value is that Humanity can arrive at reality with better questions, fewer avoidable mistakes, clearer assumptions, explicit predictions, and a visible record of what it expected to happen.
k33.t: nig2 sig5-bi ur5-am3 • nam-lu2-ulu3 zu-a-ta ki zi-sze3 mu-un-gen • inim tar-ra sig5-ta • inim sza3-ga zu-a-ta • inim u4 egir-ra sar-ra-ta • u3 dub igi-a gub-ba-ta
k33.g: its goodness is this: humankind goes to the true ground from knowledge — with better questions, with known assumptions, with written words about the after-day, and with a record standing in view

k34.e: A Thought Master uses simulation as disciplined imagination.
k34.t: lu2 gesztu2-ga-e igi-bar igi sza3-ga si sa2-a-gin7 szu-sze3 mu-un-tuku
k34.g: the person of understanding holds the looking-upon in hand as the heart's eye set in order
let the question be cut toward what may follow
let the heart's word (assumption) be spoken
let the word about the after-days (the prediction) be written
let the written word be weighed together with the true ground

k34.e: Difference becomes learning rather than embarrassment.
k34.t: nig2 bar-ra zu-zu-sze3 he2-bal • sza3 sig-ga-sze3 nu-bal
k34.g: may the divergence turn into learning • may it not turn into a lowered heart (shame)

k34.e: A failed simulation can be valuable when it exposes a weak assumption early.
k34.t: igi-bar nu-gub-ba nig2 sig5-am3 • inim sza3-ga sig u4 sag-ka pa mu-un-e3
k34.g: a looking-upon that did not stand is a good thing • it brings the weak heart-word to light in the head-days (early)

k34.e: A successful simulation remains provisional until evidence earns greater confidence.
k34.t: igi-bar sa2-dug4-ga nig2-gi-na nu-am3 • nig2-gi-na gal-sze3 he2-la2
k34.g: a looking-upon that has succeeded is not yet firm truth • let it go on being weighed toward greater proof

k34.e: This is how Innovation at the Speed of Thought becomes responsible acceleration: imagination moves quickly, consequence enters earlier, and physical exposure follows progressively stronger evidence.
k34.t: ur5-gin7 kin gesztu2-gin7 kaskal gi-na-am3 • igi sza3-ga u4 tur-ra mu-un-gen • egir-bi igi-sze3 mu-un-te • ki zi nig2-gi-na gal-ta mu-un-us2
k34.g: thus the work as swift as thought is a firm road: the heart's eye goes in a short time • the aftermath draws near to the front • the true ground follows upon ever greater proof
set forth the heart's eye greatly
let the word-of-proof be spoken with a knowing heart

k34.e: The purpose is not to remove failure from innovation.
k34.t: sag kaskal-la-bi ur5 nu-am3 • nig2 nu-gub-ba kin-ta zal-e
k34.g: the head of the road is not this: making the failing pass away from the work

k34.e: It is to move avoidable failure toward places where failure can teach more than it harms, then carry that learning forward.
k34.t: nig2 nu-gub-ba ki zu-zu-sze3 he2-gen • ki-ba nig2 nu-gub-ba mu-un-zu-zu • nu-mu-un-usz • zu-zu-bi egir-sze3 he2-tum2
k34.g: let the failing go to the place of learning • in that place the failing teaches and does not kill • let its lesson be carried onward

k35.g: thought passes away in a short day
the great house fashions it small
the achieved thing (success) fashions it into something mighty
the failed thing fashions it into a hateful thing

k35.e: Over generations, decisions can survive while their reasons disappear entirely.
k35.t: dumu-dumu-ne-ka ka-asz bar-ra mu-un-til3 • inim sza3-bi ba-zal
k35.g: through the generations the decision lives on • the word of its heart (its reason) passes away

k35.e: Humanity then inherits rules without knowing what problem they once solved and technologies without understanding what failures shaped them.
k35.t: nam-lu2-ulu3-e inim gub-ba szu-sze3 mu-un-tuku • sag-bi nu-mu-un-zu • gesz dim2-ma szu-sze3 mu-un-tuku • nig2 nu-gub-ba dim2-bi nu-mu-un-zu
k35.g: humankind receives the standing words (rules) but does not know their head (origin) • it receives the fashioned implements but does not know the failures that fashioned them

k35.e: Vision • 2525 treats this loss of context as a civilization-scale risk.
k35.t: ⟦Vision • 2525⟧ zal inim-ma-bi nig2 husz kalam-ma-gin7 mu-un-szid
k35.g: Vision • 2525 counts this passing-away of the word as a danger to the whole land

k35.e: If Humanity wants to master thought across generations, consequential thought must leave enough evidence to be reconstructed after the thinker is gone.
k35.t: nam-lu2-ulu3 dumu-dumu-ne-ta nam-gesztu2 al-di-a • gesztu2 gal-e nig2-gi-na he2-sum • u4 lu2-bi ba-usz-a-ta lu2 egir-ra-ke4 he2-du3
k35.g: if humankind desires thought-mastery across the generations, let great thought give its proof • after its person has died, let the person of after build it anew

k35.e: The objective is not perfect memory.
k35.g: the aim is not a tablet of all that exists (perfect memory)
no single tablet seizes everything that exists

k35.e: The objective is sufficient continuity: enough evidence, context, decision history, and uncertainty for another Human to understand what happened without being forced to accept the conclusions of those who came before.
k35.t: sag-bi ur5-am3 • nig2-gi-na • inim sza3-ba • ka-asz bar-ra sar-ra • u3 nig2 nu-zu-a he2-gal2 • lu2 egir-ra-ke4 nig2 gal2-la mu-un-zu • inim u4-bi-ta-ka ki-ta nu-mu-un-gub
k35.g: the aim is this: let the proof, the surrounding word (context), the written decisions, and the unknown remain • the person of after comes to know what happened • he does not stand beneath the word of the former days

k36.g: the returning tablet gives that heart (memory)

k36.e: It preserves successive states rather than quietly replacing yesterday with today.
k36.t: u4 us2-sa u4 us2-sa-bi mu-un-sar • u4-ne-e u4-bi-ta nu-mu-un-zal
k36.g: it writes day upon following day • today does not make yesterday pass away
the weighing (Compare) brings to light what turned (changed)

k36.e: Cause preserves recorded reasons for change.
k36.t: dub inim sza3-ka-ke4 inim bal-a-ka sar-ra szu mu-un-tuku
k36.g: the tablet of the heart's word (Cause) holds in hand the written word of the change

k36.e: Qualification shows what evidence permitted at a particular moment.
k36.t: inim nig2-gi-na-ka-ke4 nig2 u4-ba sum-ma pa mu-un-e3
k36.g: the word-of-proof (Qualification) brings to light what was granted on that day
these tasks are separate, one by one, by intent

k36.e: Replay can establish what happened without claiming to know every cause.
k36.t: dub gi4-gi4-e nig2 gal2-la mu-un-gar • inim sza3-bi nig2-nig2 nu-mu-un-zu
k36.g: the returning tablet establishes what happened • it does not claim to know every heart-word (cause)

k36.e: A Cause record can preserve why someone acted without proving the reasoning correct.
k36.t: dub inim sza3-ka-ke4 sag kin-ka szu mu-un-tuku • gi-na-bi nu-mu-un-gar
k36.g: the Cause tablet holds why one worked • it does not establish that the reasoning was firm

k36.e: Qualification can state readiness under defined conditions without promising universal success.
k36.t: inim nig2-gi-na-ka-ke4 nig2 gub-ba ki zu-a-ka mu-un-du11 • sa2-dug4 kalam-ma-ka nu-mu-un-du11
k36.g: the word-of-proof speaks readiness in a known place • it does not speak success for the whole land

k36.e: Separation helps keep the historical record from becoming mythology.
k36.t: bar-bar-ta dub u4-bi-ta inim lul-sze3 nu-bal
k36.g: through separation the tablet of the former days does not turn into a false word (mythology)

k36.e: Master of Thought is responsibility rather than rank: the responsibility to remain answerable for the record, especially when the record becomes inconvenient.
k36.t: en sag ki nam-kin-am3 • nam-lugal nu-am3 • lu2-bi dub-sze3 mu-un-gub • u4 dub husz-a-ka
k36.g: EN SAG.KI is duty, not kingship • its person stands for the tablet • even on the day the tablet is hateful

k37.e: The five-century horizon depends on this more than on any technology used today.
k37.t: kaskal mu ⟦500⟧ ur5-ta mu-un-gub • gesz dim2-ma u4-ne-ka-ta nu-mu-un-gub
k37.g: the road of five hundred years stands upon this • it does not stand upon the implements of today
the houses of the tablets (servers) will change
the tongues of the implements (programming languages) will pass away
the great houses (institutions) will pass away
the fashioned understandings (AI models) will be exchanged

k37.e: Future generations may reject assumptions we consider obvious.
k37.g: the children of after may cut away the heart-words we hold obvious

k37.e: They should be free to do so.
k37.g: let this lie in their own hand (they are free to do so)

k37.e: What we owe them is not obedience to our conclusions, but access to our reasoning.
k37.t: nig2 sum-ma-me ur5-am3 • inim-me-sze3 gub-ba nu-am3 • kaskal sza3 gesztu2-me-ka-am3
k37.g: what we give them is this: not a standing-under our word, but the road into the heart of our thought
on what did you cut a decision?

k37.e: Thought Mastery includes leaving those questions answerable.
k37.t: nam-gesztu2-a inim tar-ra-bi inim gi4-a he2-tuku
k37.g: within thought-mastery, those questions must have a returned word (an answer)

k37.e: A Thought Master leaves enough evidence for another Human to reconstruct what was known, decided, and observed.
k37.t: lu2 gesztu2-ga-e nig2-gi-na mu-un-sum • lu2 egir-ra-ke4 nig2 zu-a ka-asz bar-ra u3 nig2 igi-a gub-ba mu-un-du3
k37.g: the person of understanding gives proof • the person of after builds again what was known, what was decided, and what stood before the eye

k37.e: Civilization capable of Replay accumulates more than information.
k37.t: kalam dub gi4-gi4 tuku-a-ke4 nig2 nig2-szid-ta gal-la mu-un-tuku
k37.g: a land that holds the returning tablet holds something greater than countings (information)

k37.e: It accumulates qualified learning, allowing the next generation to begin upon what the past learned rather than beneath what the past declared.
k37.t: zu-zu gi-na mu-un-tuku • dumu egir-ra nig2 u4-bi-ta zu-a-ta mu-un-gub • inim u4-bi-ta du11-ga ki-ta nu-mu-un-gub
k37.g: it holds firm learning • the children of after stand upon what the former days learned • they do not stand beneath the word the former days decreed

k38.e: A civilization does not become intelligent simply because it generates data.
k38.g: a land does not gain understanding merely from fashioned countings (data)

k38.e: Intelligence appears when experience can change what happens next.
k38.t: u4 zu-a-e nig2 egir-ra mu-un-bal-a • gesztu2 pa mu-un-e3
k38.g: when lived knowing turns what comes after, understanding comes to light

k38.e: Vision • 2525 calls the architecture supporting that recursion R-CORE: signals become context, context becomes evidence, evidence supports simulation and decision, outcomes enter Replay, and qualified lessons return into future action.
k38.t: ⟦Vision • 2525⟧ gesz-hur-ba mu mu-un-sum • mu-bi ⟦R-CORE⟧ • gu3 inim-sze3 ba-bal • inim nig2-gi-na-sze3 ba-bal • nig2-gi-na-e igi-bar u3 ka-asz bar-ra mu-un-gub • egir-bi dub gi4-gi4-sze3 ba-gen • zu-zu gi-na kin u4 egir-ra-sze3 ba-gi4
k38.g: Vision • 2525 gives that design a name; its name: R-CORE • the cry turns into word • the word turns into proof • the proof stands the looking-upon and the decision upright • the aftermath goes into the returning tablet • firm lessons return into the work of the after-days

k38.e: R-CORE is not required to be one platform, one institution, one AI model, or one enormous database.
k38.t: ⟦R-CORE⟧ e2 disz nu-am3 • gesztu2 dim2-ma disz nu-am3 • dub gal disz nu-am3
k38.g: R-CORE is not one house, not one fashioned understanding, not one great tablet (database)

k38.e: It is a coordination architecture: a way for different systems to share enough durable meaning that events can become reusable learning without requiring every participant to surrender independent responsibility.
k38.t: gesz-hur kaskal disz-am3 • e2 bar-bar-ra inim disz szu-sze3 mu-un-tuku-ne • nig2 gal2-la zu-zu-sze3 ba-bal • lu2 disz-disz-e nam-kin-bi szu-ta nu-mu-un-sum
k38.g: it is a design of one road: the separate houses hold one word in hand • what happens turns into reusable learning • no single person gives his own duty out of his hand

k38.e: Its purpose is continuity across boundaries.
k38.t: sag-bi ur5-am3 • kaskal-bi ki bar-ra-ta he2-gid2
k38.g: its head (purpose) is this: may its road run long across the divided places (boundaries)

k38.e: Different technologies may come and go, but the relationships among intent, evidence, authority, decision, consequence, Replay, and learning should remain understandable.
k38.t: gesz dim2-ma mu-un-gen mu-un-zal • kaskal sza3 al-di • nig2-gi-na • nam-en • ka-asz bar-ra • egir-bi • dub gi4-gi4 • u3 zu-zu-ka he2-zu
k38.g: implements come and pass away • may the road among the heart's desire (intent), the proof, the lordship, the decision, the aftermath, the returning tablet, and the learning remain knowable

k39.g: its enduring parts are set straight (simple)

k39.e: Intent says what Humanity was trying to accomplish.
k39.t: sza3 al-di-e nig2 nam-lu2-ulu3-e al-di-a mu-un-du11
k39.g: the heart's desire (Intent) speaks what humankind was desiring to do

k39.e: Identity establishes who or what participated where necessary.
k39.g: the name (Identity) sets down which person stood in the work, where needed

k39.e: Provenance shows where information came from.
k39.t: ki inim-ma-ke4 ki sag inim-ma pa mu-un-e3
k39.g: the place-of-the-word (Provenance) brings to light the head-place from which the word came

k39.e: Requirements state what must be true.
k39.t: inim gub-ba-e nig2 gi-na-sze3 al-di-a mu-un-du11
k39.g: the standing word (Requirements) speaks what must be firm

k39.e: Risk records what may go wrong.
k39.t: dub nig2 husz-ka-ke4 nig2 nu-gub-ba mu-un-sar
k39.g: the tablet of dangers (Risk) writes what may fail to stand
the proof (Evidence) writes what stood before the eye

k39.e: Authority shows who was permitted to decide.
k39.t: nam-en-e lu2 ka-asz bar-ra-ka pa mu-un-e3
k39.g: the lordship (Authority) brings to light the person permitted the decision
the word-of-proof (Qualification) speaks what is granted
the returning tablet builds again what happened

k39.t: zu-zu-e nig2 zu-a gi-na egir-sze3 mu-un-tum2
k39.g: learning carries the firm known-things onward
the road of words (Communications) keeps carrying the voice
the looking-upon looks upon the divided (alternative) roads

k39.e: Human judgment remains responsible for consequence.
k39.g: the person's understanding stands answerable for the aftermath

k39.e: Together these functions create a recursive coordination system in which experience does not disappear after a mission, project, experiment, or decision ends.
k39.t: kin-bi disz-sze3 gesz-hur gi4-gi4-da mu-un-dim2 • u4 kin ba-zal-a-ta zu-a nu-ba-zal
k39.g: together these tasks fashion the returning design • when the work has passed, the lived knowing does not pass away

k40.e: Thought Mastery gives R-CORE its Human meaning.
k40.g: thought-mastery gives R-CORE the heart of a person

k40.e: The purpose is not to remember everything.
k40.t: sag-bi ur5 nu-am3 • nig2-nig2 szu-sze3 tuku-a
k40.g: the aim is not this: holding everything in hand

k40.e: The purpose is to remember what helps Humanity become more aware.
k40.t: sag-bi ur5-am3 • nig2 nam-lu2-ulu3 zu-a gal-sze3 tum2-a szu-sze3 tuku-a
k40.g: the aim is this: holding in hand what carries humankind toward greater awareness

k40.e: Every project should be capable of teaching the next project something.
k40.t: kin disz-disz-e kin egir-ra-ra nig2 he2-zu-zu
k40.g: may each work teach something to the work that follows

k40.e: Every failure should have an opportunity to reduce repeated failure.
k40.t: nig2 nu-gub-ba disz-disz-e nig2 nu-gub-ba gi4-a tur-sze3 he2-dim2
k40.g: may each failing fashion the returning failure toward smallness

k40.e: Every successful method should remain challengeable rather than becoming unquestioned tradition.
k40.t: kaskal sa2-dug4-ga disz-disz he2-la2 • inim u4-bi-ta gub-ba-sze3 nu-bal
k40.g: may every road that succeeded still be weighed • may it not turn into a standing word of the former days (unquestioned tradition)

k40.e: Every consequential decision should retain enough context for future Humans to understand its boundaries.
k40.t: ka-asz bar-ra gal disz-disz-e inim sza3-ba he2-tuku • lu2 egir-ra-ke4 esh2-bi he2-zu
k40.g: may each great decision keep its surrounding word • may the person of after know its rope (its boundaries)

k40.e: The cycle is technical and deeply Human: Observe.
k40.t: kaskal gi4-gi4-bi kin-am3 u3 sza3 lu2-ka-am3 • igi he2-bar
k40.g: that cycle is craft and is deeply of the human heart: look upon it

k40.e: Understand.
k40.g: know it

k40.e: Imagine.
k40.g: set forth the heart's eye (imagine)

k40.e: Simulate.
k40.g: set forth the looking-upon (simulate)

k40.e: Decide.
k40.g: cut the decision

k40.e: Act.
k40.g: do the work (act)

k40.e: Replay.
k40.g: return the tablet (replay)

k40.e: Compare.
k40.g: weigh it (compare)

k40.e: Learn.
k40.g: learn

k40.e: Improve.
k40.g: turn it toward the better (improve)

k40.e: When that cycle becomes repeatable, civilization begins converting experience into continuity.
k40.t: u4 kaskal gi4-gi4-bi gi4-gi4-da • kalam-e zu-a nig2 gid2-da-sze3 mu-un-bal
k40.g: when that returning road returns again and again, the land turns lived knowing into a long-enduring thing (continuity)

k40.e: R-CORE provides architecture beneath the cycle.
k40.g: R-CORE gives the design at the place beneath the road

k40.e: Thought Mastery provides the Human discipline that gives the cycle purpose and Human Authority determines what may responsibly advance.
k40.t: nam-gesztu2-e sza3 lu2-ka mu-un-sum • nam-en lu2-ka-ke4 nig2 gen-na ka-asz mu-un-bar
k40.g: thought-mastery gives the human heart (its purpose) • the human lordship cuts the decision on what may go forward

k41.e: Humanity has no shortage of ideas.
k41.g: humankind holds thought in abundance (no shortage of ideas)

k41.e: The greater problem is converting ideas into qualified reality without losing intent, wasting years through avoidable rediscovery, or allowing enthusiasm to outrun evidence.
k41.t: kin gal-bi ur5-am3 • gesztu2 ki zi gi-na-sze3 bal-e • sza3 al-di nu-ba-zal • mu pad3 gi4-gi4-ta nu-ba-zal • sza3 hul2 nig2-gi-na-ta igi-sze3 nu-gen
k41.g: the great task is this: turning thought into firm true ground • the heart's desire is not lost • the years do not pass away in finding-again • the joyful heart does not go out ahead of the proof

k41.e: The Humanity Innovation Engine connects the pieces already introduced into one recursive path.
k41.t: gesz dim2-ma nam-lu2-ulu3-ka-ke4 nig2-bi kaskal disz gi4-gi4-sze3 mu-un-la2
k41.g: humankind's fashioned engine binds the pieces into one returning road

k41.t: nig2 al-di lu2-ka sza3 al-di-sze3 ba-bal
k41.g: the person's need turns into the heart's desire (intent)
the people's understanding seizes the voice (listens)
the human heart turns (interprets) the word
the words of the persons (user stories) set it in order (make it clear)

k41.e: Requirements, risk, and estimates discipline the idea.
k41.t: inim gub-ba nig2 husz u3 nig2-szid-e gesztu2 si mu-un-sa2
k41.g: the standing words, the dangers, and the reckonings set the thought in order
the design fashions its body (gives it form)
the looking-upon looks upon it (explores it)
the person's lived knowing weighs (challenges) it
the reckoning and the weighing (verification and validation) test it

k41.e: Qualification establishes what can responsibly advance.
k41.g: the word-of-proof establishes what may go forward
the true ground returns what really is
the returning tablet holds the road in hand
learning returns to the head-place (begins again)

k41.e: The engine is therefore not a machine that invents for Humanity.
k41.g: this engine does not fashion thought in humankind's stead

k41.e: It is a coordination method through which Humanity can move from imagination toward evidence while preserving authority, responsibility, and the ability to learn from every meaningful attempt.
k41.t: kaskal disz-am3 • nam-lu2-ulu3 igi sza3-ga-ta nig2-gi-na-sze3 mu-un-gen • nam-en nam-kin u3 zu-zu szu-sze3 mu-un-tuku
k41.g: it is one road: humankind goes from the heart's eye toward the proof • it keeps the lordship, the duty, and the learning in its own hand

k42.e: Artificial Intelligence can accelerate almost every stage without owning the process.
k42.t: gesztu2 dim2-ma-e kaskal-bi u4 tur-sze3 mu-un-dim2 • kaskal-bi szu-sze3 nu-mu-un-tuku
k42.g: the fashioned understanding makes the road short in time • it does not take the road into its own hand

k42.e: It can help synthesize polling, draft requirements, search prior Replay, identify contradictions, generate design candidates, assist simulations, compare versions, analyze evidence, and retrieve qualified lessons from earlier projects.
k42.t: inim un-ka si mu-un-sa2 • inim gub-ba mu-un-sar • dub gi4-gi4 u4-bi-ta igi mu-un-bar • inim bar-ra pa mu-un-e3 • gesz-hur mu-un-dim2 • igi-bar-ra a2 mu-un-sum • dub dub-da mu-un-la2 • nig2-gi-na mu-un-szid • zu-zu kin u4-bi-ta-ka mu-un-tum2
k42.g: it sets the people's words in order • writes the standing words • looks upon the returning tablets of former days • brings the divided word (contradiction) to light • fashions designs • gives its arm to the looking-upon • weighs tablet against tablet • counts the proof • carries forward the lessons of former works

k42.e: This creates the possibility of dramatic compression in innovation cycles.
k42.t: ur5-ta gid2 kaskal gi4-gi4-ka tur-sze3 ba-gen
k42.g: from this, the length of the returning road may go toward smallness (compression)

k42.e: A first generation might require hundreds of exploratory iterations.
k42.t: dumu sag-e kin gi4-a mah mu-un-al-di
k42.g: the first generation requires very many repeated workings (hundreds)

k42.e: A second may inherit enough qualified learning to require dozens.
k42.t: dumu us2-sa-e zu-zu gi-na szu-sze3 mu-un-tuku • kin gi4-a-bi tur-am3
k42.g: the following generation receives firm learning in hand • its repeated workings are fewer (dozens)

k42.e: A mature third generation may require fewer still.
k42.g: for the generation after that, the repeated workings are fewer still

k42.e: The 360 → 33 → 11 hypothesis expresses that possibility, not a promised outcome.
k42.t: inim ⟦360 → 33 → 11⟧ inim sza3-ga-am3 • inim gi-na sum-ma nu-am3
k42.g: the word 360 → 33 → 11 is a heart-word (a hypothesis) • it is not a firm word given (a promised outcome)

k42.e: It must be allowed to fail honestly.
k42.g: let it be free to turn, honestly, into a thing that did not stand (to fail)

k42.e: If evidence rejects the hypothesis, the framework should preserve that result rather than protect the number.
k42.t: u4 nig2-gi-na-e inim sza3-ga mu-un-tar-a • dub-e nig2 gal2-la he2-sar • nig2-szid szu-sze3 nu-mu-un-tuku
k42.g: on the day the proof cuts away the heart-word, let the tablet write what happened • it does not take the number into a shielding hand
